desc:
Kart Wars is a fast-paced, chaotic kart racing game! 🏁 (BETA)

🏎️ Build your dream kart
💣 Unleash power-up items
🏆 Race through 7 crazy tracks!

Keep an eye out for new and consistent updates, join our community to get regular news about the game!

🎃 UPDATE v0.5.2 🎃

NEW CONTENT
- Halloween Candy Hunt! Collect candies while racing to unlock spooky rewards!
- Candy Hunt Rewards: Pumpkin Glider, Spooky title, Bat Glider, 1500 XP, Pumpkin Wheel and the Jack-o'-lantern kart!
- New Kart: Evil Kitty! LIMITED, only during the Halloween event!
- Better controller support! D-pad menu navigation and quick-action buttons.
